meanings.explanation: If something is [afar], it is a long way away from you.

examples.english: We could see the mountains [afar] in the distance.
examples.chinese: 我们可以看到[远处]的群山。

examples.english: The ship sailed [afar] across the ocean.
examples.chinese: 那艘船向[远方]驶去，穿越大海。

examples.english: My grandmother watched us play [afar] from her window.
examples.chinese: 我奶奶从窗户[远远]地看着我们玩耍。

meanings.explanation: An [aspect] of something is one of the parts or features of it.

examples.english: We should think about every [aspect] of this plan.
examples.chinese: 我们应该考虑这个计划的每个[方面]。

examples.english: Reading is an important [aspect] of learning.
examples.chinese: 阅读是学习的一个重要[方面]。

examples.english: She likes every [aspect] of her new school.
examples.chinese: 她喜欢新学校的每一个[方面]。

meanings.explanation: The [aspect] of something is the way it looks or appears.

examples.english: The old house has a beautiful [aspect] from the garden.
examples.chinese: 从花园望去，这栋老房子[外观]很美。

examples.english: We painted the room to change its [aspect].
examples.chinese: 我们粉刷了房间，想改变它的[外观]。

examples.english: The lake has a peaceful [aspect] at sunset.
examples.chinese: 日落时分，湖面呈现出宁静的[景象]。

meanings.explanation: If you are [alert], you are paying close attention to what is happening around you so that you can quickly notice anything unusual or dangerous.

examples.english: The dog is always [alert] when someone knocks on the door.
examples.chinese: 有人敲门时，狗总是很[警觉]。

examples.english: You must stay [alert] when you cross the street.
examples.chinese: 过马路时一定要保持[警觉]。

examples.english: The cat looked very [alert] as it watched the bird outside.
examples.chinese: 猫盯着外面的鸟时，显得非常[机警]。

meanings.explanation: If you [alert] someone to something, you warn or notify them about it so they can take notice or action.

examples.english: My dad [alerted] me about the heavy rain coming.
examples.chinese: 爸爸[提醒]我马上要下大雨了。

examples.english: The teacher [alerted] us that the test would start in five minutes.
examples.chinese: 老师[提醒]我们还有五分钟就开始考试了。

examples.english: I will [alert] you when dinner is ready.
examples.chinese: 晚饭好了我会[通知]你。

meanings.explanation: A [Greek] is a person who comes from Greece, or the main language spoken in Greece.

examples.english: My cousin is married to a [Greek].
examples.chinese: 我表哥娶了一位[希腊人]。

examples.english: Can you speak any [Greek]?
examples.chinese: 你会说[希腊语]吗？

examples.english: This word comes from ancient [Greek].
examples.chinese: 这个词源自古[希腊语]。

meanings.explanation: [Greek] things relate to Greece, its people, culture, or its language.

examples.english: I love eating [Greek] salad with feta cheese.
examples.chinese: 我喜欢吃配菲达奶酪的[希腊]沙拉。

examples.english: We watched a [Greek] movie last night.
examples.chinese: 我们昨晚看了一部[希腊]电影。

examples.english: [Greek] mythology has many interesting gods.
examples.chinese: [希腊]神话有很多有趣的神。

meanings.explanation: If you [attempt] to do something, you try to do it, especially something difficult.

examples.english: I will [attempt] to climb that tall tree.
examples.chinese: 我要[试着]爬那棵高树。

examples.english: She [attempted] to bake a cake all by herself.
examples.chinese: 她[尝试]自己烤蛋糕。

examples.english: The cat [attempted] to catch the mouse but failed.
examples.chinese: 那只猫[试图]抓老鼠，但没成功。

meanings.explanation: An [attempt] is an act of trying to do something, especially something difficult.

examples.english: My first [attempt] at riding a bike was very funny.
examples.chinese: 我第一次[尝试]骑自行车的时候非常搞笑。

examples.english: He made an [attempt] to answer the question.
examples.chinese: 他[试图]回答那个问题。

examples.english: Her [attempt] to draw a cat was really cute.
examples.chinese: 她[画的]那只猫真的很可爱。

meanings.explanation: The [background] is the part of a picture, photograph, or scene that is behind the main people or objects.

examples.english: The mountains in the [background] of the photo look very beautiful.
examples.chinese: 照片[背景]里的山看起来很美。

examples.english: She painted a blue sky in the [background] of her picture.
examples.chinese: 她在画的[背景]上画了蓝色的天空。

examples.english: The children smiled while standing in front of trees in the [background].
examples.chinese: 孩子们微笑着，[背景]是树木。

meanings.explanation: Your [background] is your family, education, and the experiences you have had in your life.

examples.english: She comes from a [background] where everyone loves reading books.
examples.chinese: 她来自一个大家都爱看书的[家庭背景]。

examples.english: My teacher has a strong [background] in music.
examples.chinese: 我的老师有很强的音乐[背景]。

examples.english: We have students from many different [background]s in our school.
examples.chinese: 我们学校有来自各种不同[背景]的学生。

meanings.explanation: [Harvard] is a famous university in Cambridge, Massachusetts, USA. It is one of the oldest and most respected universities in the world.

examples.english: My big sister wants to study at [Harvard].
examples.chinese: 我姐姐想去[哈佛]读书。

examples.english: [Harvard] is a very famous university in America.
examples.chinese: [哈佛]是美国一所非常有名的大学。

examples.english: Many smart students dream of going to [Harvard].
examples.chinese: 很多聪明的学生都梦想去[哈佛]上学。

meanings.explanation: [Harvard] is used to describe people, things, or places that are connected with Harvard University.

examples.english: She is a [Harvard] student.
examples.chinese: 她是一名[哈佛]学生。

examples.english: The [Harvard] library has millions of books.
examples.chinese: [哈佛]图书馆有上百万本书。

examples.english: He was proud to be a [Harvard] graduate.
examples.chinese: 他为自己是一名[哈佛]毕业生而自豪。

meanings.explanation: [Altogether] means completely or totally. It is used to emphasize that something is wholly true or the case.

examples.english: The birthday cake was [altogether] wonderful.
examples.chinese: 这个生日蛋糕[完全]棒极了。

examples.english: This is an [altogether] new situation for me.
examples.chinese: 这对我来说是[完全]全新的情况。

examples.english: I am [altogether] sure about the answer.
examples.chinese: 我对这个答案[完全]有把握。

meanings.explanation: [Altogether] means in total or when you count everything together. It is used to give a final count or sum.

examples.english: There are twenty students [altogether] in the class.
examples.chinese: 班里[总共有]二十个学生。

examples.english: I have read five books [altogether] this year.
examples.chinese: 今年我[一共]读了五本书。

examples.english: The trip cost 500 dollars [altogether].
examples.chinese: 这趟旅行[总共]花了500美元。

meanings.explanation: If someone or something [becomes famous for] something, they are widely known and recognized by the public because of that particular thing.

examples.english: This small town [became famous for] its beautiful cherry blossoms.
examples.chinese: 这个小镇因其漂亮的樱花而[出名]。

examples.english: She [became famous for] singing the song on TV.
examples.chinese: 她因为在电视上唱了那首歌而[出名]。

examples.english: The restaurant [became famous for] its delicious dumplings.
examples.chinese: 这家餐厅因为好吃的饺子而[出名]。

meanings.explanation: A [board] is a flat piece of wood or other material that is used for a particular purpose, such as building, playing games, or serving food.

examples.english: The carpenter cut the [board] into two pieces.
examples.chinese: 木匠把[木板]切成两块。

examples.english: We put the chess [board] on the table and started playing.
examples.chinese: 我们把棋[盘]放在桌上开始下棋。

examples.english: The teacher wrote the homework on the [board].
examples.chinese: 老师把作业写在[黑板]上。

meanings.explanation: When you [board] a vehicle such as a bus, plane, or train, you get on it.

examples.english: Please [board] the bus through the front door.
examples.chinese: 请从前门[上车]。

examples.english: Passengers must [board] the plane before 2 o'clock.
examples.chinese: 乘客必须在2点前[登机]。

examples.english: The children [boarded] the school bus every morning.
examples.chinese: 孩子们每天早上[乘坐]校车。

meanings.explanation: [Anxiety] is a feeling of worry, nervousness, or unease about something that may happen.

examples.english: I feel a lot of [anxiety] before every school test.
examples.chinese: 每次学校考试前我都会感到强烈的[焦虑]。

examples.english: Her [anxiety] about the picnic went away when it stopped raining.
examples.chinese: 雨停之后，她对野餐的[焦虑]就消失了。

examples.english: Taking a deep breath can help you calm your [anxiety].
examples.chinese: 深呼吸可以帮你平复[焦虑]。

meanings.explanation: [Anxiety] is a long-term mental health condition that causes constant strong worry and fear, making daily life difficult.

examples.english: My aunt sees a doctor to help manage her [anxiety].
examples.chinese: 我阿姨看医生来帮助控制她的[焦虑症]。

examples.english: Many people with [anxiety] get better with the right help.
examples.chinese: 很多患有[焦虑症]的人在得到合适的帮助后都会好转。

examples.english: [Anxiety] can make it hard to fall asleep at night.
examples.chinese: [焦虑症]会让人晚上难以入睡。

meanings.explanation: If someone or something [amazes] you, they make you feel extremely surprised, usually because they are so good, clever, or impressive that you did not expect them to be that way.

examples.english: The clever dog [amazed] everyone with its tricks.
examples.chinese: 那只聪明的狗狗用把戏让所有人都[惊叹]。

examples.english: It [amazes] me how fast children learn new things.
examples.chinese: 孩子们学新东西这么快，真让我[惊叹]。

examples.english: Her beautiful painting [amazed] all her classmates.
examples.chinese: 她那幅漂亮的画让所有同学都[惊叹]。

meanings.explanation: A [calorie] is a unit that measures how much energy food contains or how much energy your body gets from food.

examples.english: This apple has about 52 [calories].
examples.chinese: 这个苹果大约有52[卡路里]。

examples.english: My mom looks at [calorie] labels when she buys snacks for us.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈给我们买零食时会看[卡路里]标签。

examples.english: Drinking water has zero [calories].
examples.chinese: 喝水不会摄入[卡路里]。

meanings.explanation: A [calorie] is also a measure of how much energy your body burns when you exercise or move your body.

examples.english: I burned 100 [calories] by riding my bike for 30 minutes.
examples.chinese: 我骑了30分钟自行车，[消耗]了100[卡路里]。

examples.english: Running helps you burn more [calories] than walking.
examples.chinese: 跑步比走路[消耗]更多[卡路里]。

examples.english: My dad uses a watch to track how many [calories] he burns each day.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸用手表记录他每天要[消耗]多少[卡路里]。

meanings.explanation: A [capsicum] is a large, hollow vegetable with a mild, sweet flavor, typically green, red, or yellow. It is also called a bell pepper or sweet pepper.

examples.english: Mom put some chopped [capsicum] into the fried rice.
examples.chinese: 妈妈往炒饭里放了些切碎的[灯笼椒]。

examples.english: I don't like eating raw [capsicum] because it tastes a bit bitter.
examples.chinese: 我不喜欢生吃[甜椒]，因为吃起来有点苦。

examples.english: Could you buy a red [capsicum] and a green one from the market?
examples.chinese: 你能从菜市场买一个红[甜椒]和一个绿[甜椒]吗？

meanings.explanation: You use [barely] to say that something is only just true or possible, and is almost not the case.

examples.english: I [barely] caught the school bus this morning.
examples.chinese: 我[勉强]赶上了今早的校车。

examples.english: The room is so dark that I can [barely] see anything.
examples.chinese: 房间太黑了，我[几乎不]能看见任何东西。

examples.english: She [barely] ate any dinner because she wasn't hungry.
examples.chinese: 因为不饿，她[几乎没]吃晚饭。

meanings.explanation: You use [barely] to indicate that something has only a very small amount of a particular quality or exists only to a very small degree.

examples.english: The soup is [barely] warm after sitting out for an hour.
examples.chinese: 放了一个小时后，这汤[几乎不]热了。

examples.english: I [barely] remember what happened when I was a baby.
examples.chinese: 我[几乎不]记得我婴儿时期发生的事。

examples.english: We [barely] know each other after only one meeting.
examples.chinese: 我们只见过一次，[几乎不]了解彼此。

meanings.explanation: A [cactus] is a type of plant that grows in hot, dry places. It has thick stems that store water, and its leaves are usually sharp spines.

examples.english: I keep a small [cactus] on my desk at home.
examples.chinese: 我在家里的书桌上放了一盆小[仙人掌]。

examples.english: The [cactus] can live for months without water.
examples.chinese: [仙人掌]几个月不浇水也能活。

examples.english: My friend gave me a beautiful [cactus] for my birthday.
examples.chinese: 我朋友送了我一棵漂亮的[仙人掌]当生日礼物。

meanings.explanation: A [comic] is a magazine that contains stories told through pictures, often about superheroes or funny characters.

examples.english: I read a [comic] about a superhero every week.
examples.chinese: 我每周都读一本关于超级英雄的[漫画]。

examples.english: She drew a funny [comic] for the school newspaper.
examples.chinese: 她为校报画了一幅搞笑的[漫画]。

examples.english: My little brother loves reading [comic] books before bed.
examples.chinese: 我弟弟睡前喜欢看[漫画]书。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [comic] is funny or amusing and makes people laugh.

examples.english: The clown's [comic] dance made everyone laugh.
examples.chinese: 小丑[滑稽的]舞蹈逗得大家哈哈大笑。

examples.english: He has a [comic] way of telling stories.
examples.chinese: 他讲故事的方式很[滑稽]。

examples.english: The movie was full of [comic] moments.
examples.chinese: 这部电影充满了[搞笑的]片段。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [classic] is extremely good and typical of its kind, and has become a standard for others.

examples.english: The little black dress is a [classic] choice for parties.
examples.chinese: 小黑裙是参加派对的[经典]选择。

examples.english: This [classic] movie is still fun to watch after 50 years.
examples.chinese: 这部[经典]电影过了50年依然好看。

examples.english: My mom loves [classic] music from the 1980s.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈喜欢上世纪80年代的[经典]音乐。

meanings.explanation: A [classic] is a book, film, or song of high quality that has been popular for a long time and is still admired.

examples.english: Many children read the [classic] 'Charlotte's Web' at school.
examples.chinese: 很多孩子在学校读《夏洛的网》这本[经典作品]。

examples.english: This car is a [classic] from the 1960s.
examples.chinese: 这辆车是上世纪60年代的[经典款]。

examples.english: My grandmother gave me a [classic] by Mark Twain.
examples.chinese: 我奶奶给了我一本马克·吐温的[经典著作]。

meanings.explanation: An [amount] of something is how much of that thing there is, or a quantity of it.

examples.english: The [amount] of students in our class is thirty.
examples.chinese: 我们班上学生的[人数]是三十人。

examples.english: The total [amount] for this book is twenty yuan.
examples.chinese: 这本书的[总价]是二十元。

examples.english: This [amount] of rice is enough for lunch.
examples.chinese: 这[份量]的米饭够午餐吃了。

meanings.explanation: [Addition] is the process of adding two or more numbers together to find their total.

examples.english: Today we learned how to do [addition] in math class.
examples.chinese: 今天我们在数学课上学习了怎么做[加法]。

examples.english: Three plus five equals eight is a simple [addition] problem.
examples.chinese: 三加五等于八是一道简单的[加法]题。

examples.english: My little sister is practicing [addition] with her fingers.
examples.chinese: 我的小妹妹正在用手指练习[加法]。

meanings.explanation: An [addition] is something that is added to something else, making it bigger, better, or more complete.

examples.english: The new library is a welcome [addition] to our neighborhood.
examples.chinese: 新图书馆是我们社区受欢迎的[新设施]。

examples.english: We built an [addition] to our house to make more room.
examples.chinese: 我们给房子做了[扩建]，这样空间就更大了。

examples.english: This new book is a wonderful [addition] to my collection.
examples.chinese: 这本新书是我收藏中一个很棒的[新成员]。

meanings.explanation: A [way] is a method or manner of doing something.

examples.english: Walking is a great [way] to relax after school.
examples.chinese: 散步是放学后放松的好[方法]。

examples.english: Can you show me a good [way] to solve this math problem?
examples.chinese: 你能告诉我解这道数学题的好[方法]吗？

examples.english: Reading books is a wonderful [way] to learn new things.
examples.chinese: 读书是学习新知识的绝佳[方法]。

meanings.explanation: The [audience] is the group of people who watch or listen to a performance, speech, or show.

examples.english: The [audience] clapped their hands at the end of the show.
examples.chinese: 演出结束时，[观众]们鼓起了掌。

examples.english: The magician made the [audience] laugh and cheer.
examples.chinese: 魔术师让[观众]们又是笑又是欢呼。

examples.english: There was a big [audience] at the football game.
examples.chinese: 这场足球赛来了很多[观众]。

meanings.explanation: The [audience] of a book, movie, or program is the particular group of people who read, watch, or listen to it.

examples.english: This comic book is for a young [audience].
examples.chinese: 这本漫画书是给年轻[读者]的。

examples.english: The TV show has a huge [audience] around the world.
examples.chinese: 这个电视节目在全球有很多[观众]。

examples.english: The writer hopes to reach a wider [audience] with her new book.
examples.chinese: 这位作家希望她的新书能吸引更多[读者]。

meanings.explanation: The [climate] of a place is the general weather conditions that are typical of it.

examples.english: Hawaii has a warm [climate] all year round.
examples.chinese: 夏威夷全年都有温暖的[气候]。

examples.english: My grandma likes the dry [climate] in Beijing.
examples.chinese: 我奶奶喜欢北京干燥的[气候]。

examples.english: A tropical [climate] has lots of rain and sun.
examples.chinese: 热带[气候]有很多雨水和阳光。

meanings.explanation: The [climate] of a situation or group is the general mood or feeling that exists there.

examples.english: The friendly [climate] in our classroom makes me happy.
examples.chinese: 我们教室里友好的[氛围]让我很开心。

examples.english: We need a good [climate] to play games together.
examples.chinese: 我们需要好的[氛围]一起玩游戏。

examples.english: A kind [climate] makes everyone feel welcome.
examples.chinese: 友善的[氛围]让每个人都感到受欢迎。

meanings.explanation: A [contestant] is a person who takes part in a competition, game, or contest.

examples.english: The [contestant] answered every question correctly and won the prize.
examples.chinese: 这位[参赛选手]答对了所有问题，赢得了奖品。

examples.english: My sister was the youngest [contestant] in the singing competition.
examples.chinese: 我姐姐是这场歌唱比赛中最年轻的[选手]。

examples.english: All the [contestants] stood on stage and waited for the results.
examples.chinese: 所有的[参赛者]都站在舞台上等待结果。

meanings.explanation: When you [design] something, you plan how it will look, work, or be made before it is actually created.

examples.english: My dad is going to [design] a treehouse for us this weekend.
examples.chinese: 这周末我爸要给我们[设计]一个树屋。

examples.english: She wants to [design] her own birthday cake.
examples.chinese: 她想自己[设计]生日蛋糕。

examples.english: Our teacher asked us to [design] a poster for the school fair.
examples.chinese: 老师让我们为学校义卖会[设计]一张海报。

meanings.explanation: A [design] is a plan or drawing that shows how something will look or work, or the way something is shaped and decorated.

examples.english: I love the [design] of your new school bag.
examples.chinese: 我很喜欢你新书包的[设计]。

examples.english: The [design] of the new park makes everyone happy.
examples.chinese: 新公园的[设计]让每个人都觉得很棒。

examples.english: Look at the beautiful flower [design] on this cup!
examples.chinese: 你看这个杯子上的花朵[图案]多漂亮！

meanings.explanation: To [describe] someone or something means to say what they are like or what happened.

examples.english: Can you [describe] your new puppy to me?
examples.chinese: 你能跟我[描述]一下你的新小狗吗？

examples.english: She likes to [describe] her summer vacation to her classmates.
examples.chinese: 她喜欢给同学们[描述]她的暑假生活。

examples.english: The boy tried to [describe] the strange noise he heard last night.
examples.chinese: 那个男孩试着[描述]他昨晚听到的奇怪声音。

meanings.explanation: Something [current] is happening now or is present at this time.

examples.english: What is the [current] time?
examples.chinese: 现在[几点]？

examples.english: The [current] leader is very popular.
examples.chinese: 这位[现任]领导很受欢迎。

examples.english: I need to know the [current] price.
examples.chinese: 我需要知道[当前]的价格。

meanings.explanation: A [current] is a steady flow of water, air, or electricity moving in one direction.

examples.english: The river has a strong [current].
examples.chinese: 这条河水流[很急]。

examples.english: Please turn off the [current] before fixing the wire.
examples.chinese: 修电线之前请先关掉[电流]。

examples.english: Swimmers should be careful of the [current].
examples.chinese: 游泳的人要小心[水流]。

meanings.explanation: If you [donate] something, such as money or goods, you give it to a person or organization that needs help.

examples.english: Our family decided to [donate] some old books to the school library.
examples.chinese: 我们家决定把一些旧书[捐赠]给学校图书馆。

examples.english: Many people [donate] money to help sick children every year.
examples.chinese: 每年都有很多人[捐钱]来帮助生病的孩子。

examples.english: My dad wants to [donate] blood at the hospital next week.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸下周想去医院[献血]。

meanings.explanation: A [competitor] is a person who takes part in a competition or contest.

examples.english: There are twelve [competitors] in the running race.
examples.chinese: 跑步比赛有十二名[选手]。

examples.english: Every [competitor] trained hard for the big game.
examples.chinese: 每位[选手]都为了大赛努力训练。

examples.english: The youngest [competitor] won first prize.
examples.chinese: 最年轻的[选手]赢得了第一名。

meanings.explanation: A [competitor] is a person or company that tries to be more successful than another in business or trade.

examples.english: The two bakeries on our street are [competitors].
examples.chinese: 我们街上那两家面包店是[竞争对手]。

examples.english: Our biggest [competitor] just opened a new store.
examples.chinese: 我们最大的[竞争对手]刚开了一家新店。

examples.english: That phone company has many [competitors] in the market.
examples.chinese: 那家手机公司在市场上有很多[竞争对手]。

meanings.explanation: [Elementary] means relating to the basic parts of a subject, or simple and easy to understand. It is often used to describe the first stages of learning something.

examples.english: My little sister goes to an [elementary] school near our home.
examples.chinese: 我的妹妹去我们家附近的一所[小学]上学。

examples.english: This book teaches the [elementary] rules of drawing.
examples.chinese: 这本书教你绘画的[基础]规则。

examples.english: The math questions in this test are quite [elementary].
examples.chinese: 这次考试里的数学题相当[基础]。

meanings.explanation: [Elementary] can also describe something that is easy or simple, sometimes used to emphasize that something is obvious or should be easy to understand.

examples.english: The answer to this question is [elementary].
examples.chinese: 这个问题的答案再[简单]不过了。

examples.english: Even a child can solve this [elementary] problem.
examples.chinese: 连小孩子都能解决这个[简单的]问题。

examples.english: She made an [elementary] error in spelling the word.
examples.chinese: 她在拼写这个词时犯了一个[低级的]错误。

meanings.explanation: An [emotion] is a strong feeling such as joy, anger, fear, or love.

examples.english: She felt a sudden [emotion] of happiness when she saw her dog.
examples.chinese: 看到她的狗狗时，她突然感到一阵[喜悦]。

examples.english: His voice shook because he could not hide his [emotion].
examples.chinese: 他的声音颤抖了，因为他藏不住自己的[情绪]。

examples.english: Sometimes it is hard to control your [emotion]s.
examples.chinese: 有时候很难控制自己的[情感]。

meanings.explanation: [Effort] is the physical or mental energy that you use in order to do something.

examples.english: Putting more [effort] into your drawing will make it better.
examples.chinese: 在你的画画上多花[力气]会让它变得更好。

examples.english: Climbing the big hill took all my [effort].
examples.chinese: 爬这座大山花了我所有的[力气]。

examples.english: She saved her [effort] for the final race.
examples.chinese: 她把[力气]留到最后一场比赛。

meanings.explanation: An [effort] is a particular attempt to do something, especially something difficult.

examples.english: I made an [effort] to clean my room today.
examples.chinese: 我今天为打扫房间付出了[努力]。

examples.english: His [effort] to help the little boy was very kind.
examples.chinese: 他帮助小男孩的[努力]十分暖心。

examples.english: The team won the game because of their joint [effort].
examples.chinese: 这支队伍因为共同的[努力]赢得了比赛。

meanings.explanation: A [director] is a person who is in charge of making a film, play, or television program, by telling the actors and crew what to do.

examples.english: The [director] told the actors where to stand on the stage.
examples.chinese: [导演]告诉演员们该站在舞台上的什么位置。

examples.english: My favorite [director] made a new cartoon movie.
examples.chinese: 我最喜欢的[导演]拍了一部新的动画电影。

examples.english: The play [director] asked everyone to practice their lines again.
examples.chinese: 这部话剧的[导演]让大家再把台词练一遍。

meanings.explanation: A [director] is a person who is in charge of an organization, company, or department, and makes important decisions.

examples.english: Her father is a company [director] who leads a big team.
examples.chinese: 她爸爸是一家公司的[董事]，带领着一个大团队。

examples.english: The camp [director] planned fun games for all the children.
examples.chinese: 夏令营[负责人]为所有孩子安排了有趣的游戏。

examples.english: Our school [director] gave a speech at the morning assembly.
examples.chinese: 我们学校的[校长]在晨会上发表了讲话。

meanings.explanation: The [environment] is the natural world, including the land, water, air, plants, and animals.

examples.english: We should take care of the [environment] by not throwing trash on the ground.
examples.chinese: 我们应该爱护[环境]，不要在地上扔垃圾。

examples.english: Many animals lose their homes when the [environment] is damaged.
examples.chinese: 当[环境]遭到破坏时，许多动物会失去家园。

examples.english: Planting trees helps make the [environment] better and cleaner.
examples.chinese: 种树有助于让[环境]变得更美好、更干净。

meanings.explanation: Your [environment] is the place where you live, work, or study, and all the things that affect you there.

examples.english: A quiet classroom creates a good [environment] for learning.
examples.chinese: 安静的教室营造了良好的学习[环境]。

examples.english: My mom put plants in our home to make a happy [environment].
examples.chinese: 我妈妈在家里摆放了植物，营造出温馨的[环境]。

examples.english: Working with kind people makes a friendly [environment] at the office.
examples.chinese: 和友善的人一起工作，让办公室形成了友好的[氛围]。

meanings.explanation: A [firework] is a small device that contains explosive chemicals and produces bright colored lights and loud noises when you light it, often used for celebrations.

examples.english: We watched beautiful [fireworks] on New Year's Eve.
examples.chinese: 除夕夜我们观看了美丽的[烟花]。

examples.english: The children love to see [fireworks] light up the night sky.
examples.chinese: 孩子们喜欢看[烟花]点亮夜空。

examples.english: My dad bought some [fireworks] for my birthday party.
examples.chinese: 爸爸为我的生日派对买了一些[烟花]。

meanings.explanation: If you [force] someone to do something, you make them do it even though they do not want to.

examples.english: Don't [force] your little brother to eat all the vegetables.
examples.chinese: 别[强迫]你弟弟把所有蔬菜都吃完。

examples.english: Mom didn't [force] me to go to bed early last night.
examples.chinese: 昨晚妈妈没有[强迫]我早睡。

examples.english: You can't [force] a cat to take a bath if it doesn't want to.
examples.chinese: 如果猫不想洗澡，你是不能[硬逼着]它洗的。

meanings.explanation: [Force] is physical strength or power, or a strong influence that causes something to happen.

examples.english: The strong wind had enough [force] to blow away the umbrella.
examples.chinese: 大风的[风力]大到能把雨伞吹走。

examples.english: He hit the ball with a lot of [force].
examples.chinese: 他用很大的[力]击中了球。

examples.english: Love is the greatest [force] in the world.
examples.chinese: 爱是世界上最大的[力量]。

meanings.explanation: If you [deal] with a problem, a situation, or a person, you take action to solve it, manage it, or handle it.

examples.english: I don't know how to [deal] with this messy room.
examples.chinese: 我不知道该怎么[处理]这个乱糟糟的房间。

examples.english: She learned to [deal] with her fear of speaking in class.
examples.chinese: 她学会了[应对]在班上发言的恐惧。

examples.english: We have to [deal] with the dirty dishes before watching TV.
examples.chinese: 我们得先[收拾]这些脏碗盘才能看电视。

meanings.explanation: A [deal] is an agreement or arrangement between two people or groups, especially about buying, selling, or doing something together.

examples.english: We made a [deal] to help each other with homework.
examples.chinese: 我们达成了互相帮助做作业的[协议]。

examples.english: The two friends kept their [deal] and shared the candy equally.
examples.chinese: 两个朋友遵守了[约定]，把糖果平分了。

examples.english: That used bike was a real [deal] at only twenty dollars.
examples.chinese: 那辆二手自行车才二十美元，真是个好[买卖]。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [far-off] is a long distance away from where you are or from where something else is.

examples.english: We could see the [far-off] mountains from the top of the hill.
examples.chinese: 从山顶我们能看到[远处]的山脉。

examples.english: My grandmother lives in a [far-off] village.
examples.chinese: 我奶奶住在一个[遥远的]村庄里。

examples.english: The [far-off] sounds of the ocean made me feel peaceful.
examples.chinese: [远处]传来的海浪声让我感到平静。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [far-off] happened a very long time ago or will happen a long time in the future.

examples.english: In the [far-off] future, people might live on Mars.
examples.chinese: 在[遥远的]未来，人类也许会住在火星上。

examples.english: She remembered the [far-off] days when she was a little girl.
examples.chinese: 她想起了[很久以前]她还是个小女孩时的日子。

examples.english: That happened in a [far-off] time, long before you were born.
examples.chinese: 那件事发生在[很久以前]，远在你出生之前。

common_collocations: in the heat of the moment

meanings.explanation: [Heat] is the quality of being hot, or the feeling of something being hot. It can also refer to warm weather or high temperatures.

examples.english: The [heat] from the stove made the kitchen very warm.
examples.chinese: 炉子发出的[热量]让厨房变得很暖和。

examples.english: I cannot sleep well in this [heat].
examples.chinese: 这么[热]的天我睡不着觉。

examples.english: The [heat] of the sun feels great on my skin.
examples.chinese: 太阳的[热量]照在皮肤上感觉好极了。

meanings.explanation: When you [heat] something, you make it become warm or hot, often by using a stove, oven, or microwave.

examples.english: Can you [heat] up the soup for lunch?
examples.chinese: 你能把汤[热]一下当午饭吗？

examples.english: Mom will [heat] some milk before bedtime.
examples.chinese: 妈妈会在睡前[加热]一些牛奶。

examples.english: Please [heat] the water to make tea.
examples.chinese: 请把水[加热]来泡茶。

meanings.explanation: [Fuel] is a substance such as gas, oil, or coal that is used to produce heat or power.

examples.english: Our car uses too much [fuel].
examples.chinese: 我们的汽车消耗太多[燃料]了。

examples.english: The price of [fuel] is very high now.
examples.chinese: 现在[燃料]的价格很高。

examples.english: Wood is a cheap [fuel] for heating.
examples.chinese: 木头是一种便宜的取暖[燃料]。

meanings.explanation: To [fuel] something means to supply it with fuel, or to increase or strengthen something.

examples.english: We stopped to [fuel] the car.
examples.chinese: 我们停下来给汽车[加油]。

examples.english: The debate was [fueled] by angry words.
examples.chinese: 这场辩论被愤怒的话语[激化]了。

examples.english: The plane needs to [fuel] up before the long trip.
examples.chinese: 飞机在长途旅行前需要[加油]。

meanings.explanation: The [flu] is a common infectious illness that causes fever, weakness, and body aches.

examples.english: I stayed home from school because I caught the [flu].
examples.chinese: 我因为得了[流感]，所以没去上学。

examples.english: My mom got the [flu] last week and rested in bed.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈上周得了[流感]，在床上休息。

examples.english: We got a vaccine to prevent the [flu] this year.
examples.chinese: 今年我们打了疫苗来预防[流感]。

meanings.explanation: A species of animal or plant that is [extinct] no longer exists. You can also say that a type of thing is [extinct] when it has completely disappeared from the world.

examples.english: Dinosaurs are [extinct] now.
examples.chinese: 恐龙现在已经[灭绝]了。

examples.english: We must protect pandas, or they will become [extinct].
examples.chinese: 我们必须保护大熊猫，否则它们就会[灭绝]。

examples.english: The dodo is a kind of [extinct] bird.
examples.chinese: 渡渡鸟是一种已经[灭绝]的鸟。

meanings.explanation: An [extinct] volcano is one that is no longer active and will not erupt again.

examples.english: This [extinct] volcano has not erupted for thousands of years.
examples.chinese: 这座[死]火山已经几千年没有喷发了。

examples.english: Scientists say this mountain is an [extinct] volcano.
examples.chinese: 科学家说这座山是一座[死]火山。

examples.english: We climbed an [extinct] volcano during our school trip.
examples.chinese: 学校郊游时，我们爬了一座[死]火山。

meanings.explanation: If you [hire] someone, you employ them or pay them to work for you. If you [hire] something, you pay to use it for a period of time.

examples.english: Our company decided to [hire] three new workers.
examples.chinese: 我们公司决定[雇用]三个新工人。

examples.english: We need to [hire] a car for the weekend trip.
examples.chinese: 我们周末旅行需要[租]一辆车。

examples.english: She was [hired] as a manager last month.
examples.chinese: 她上个月被[招聘]为经理。

meanings.explanation: [Hire] is the act of paying to use something, or the money you pay for this. It can also refer to someone who has been employed.

examples.english: The [hire] of a bike costs 10 dollars per day.
examples.chinese: 自行车[租费]每天10美元。

examples.english: All new [hires] must attend training next week.
examples.chinese: 所有新[入职]的人员下周必须参加培训。

examples.english: This boat is available for [hire].
examples.chinese: 这艘船可供[租用]。

meanings.explanation: Someone who is [greedy] wants more food than they need.

examples.english: The [greedy] dog ate all the cookies on the table.
examples.chinese: 那只[贪吃的]狗把桌上的饼干全吃了。

examples.english: Don't be [greedy] — leave some cake for your sister.
examples.chinese: 别[贪嘴]——给你妹妹留点蛋糕。

examples.english: The [greedy] boy took three pieces of candy.
examples.chinese: 那个[贪心的]男孩拿了三个糖果。

meanings.explanation: Someone who is [greedy] wants more money or power than they need.

examples.english: The [greedy] king took all the gold from his people.
examples.chinese: 那个[贪婪的]国王把百姓所有的金子都拿走了。

examples.english: The [greedy] businessman never shared his money.
examples.chinese: 那个[贪得无厌的]商人从不分享他的钱财。

examples.english: Being too [greedy] can make you lose friends.
examples.chinese: 太[贪心]会让你失去朋友。

meanings.explanation: When a wound or injury [heals], or when something [heals] it, it becomes healthy and whole again.

examples.english: My small cut [healed] in just three days.
examples.chinese: 我的小伤口三天就[愈合]了。

examples.english: This ointment helps [heal] your bad sunburn.
examples.chinese: 这个药膏有助于[治愈]你的严重晒伤。

examples.english: After the fall, his broken leg took months to [heal].
examples.chinese: 摔倒之后，他骨折的腿花了好几个月才[愈合]。

meanings.explanation: If something [heals] you when you are feeling sad or hurt, it makes you feel better again.

examples.english: Time [heals] all the sad things in our life.
examples.chinese: 时间会[抚平]我们生活中所有伤心的事。

examples.english: My mom's warm hug [healed] my bad mood right away.
examples.chinese: 妈妈温暖的拥抱很快就[治愈]了我的坏心情。

examples.english: Talking to your best friend can help [heal] a broken heart.
examples.chinese: 和好朋友聊天有助于[治愈]你受伤的心。

meanings.explanation: If you say that something is [in bad taste], you mean that it is offensive and not suitable for the situation.

examples.english: His joke about her age was [in bad taste].
examples.chinese: 他拿她的年龄开玩笑真是[没品味]。

examples.english: I think mentioning money at the party was [in bad taste].
examples.chinese: 我觉得在聚会上谈钱太[不得体]了。

examples.english: Wearing shorts to the wedding was [in bad taste].
examples.chinese: 穿短裤去参加婚礼太[不合适]了。

meanings.explanation: [Honor] is the respect that you show to someone because they have done something good or have high moral standards.

examples.english: The soldier received a medal for his [honor] and bravery.
examples.chinese: 这位士兵因其[荣誉]和勇敢而获得勋章。

examples.english: It is a great [honor] to meet the famous scientist.
examples.chinese: 见到这位著名科学家是巨大的[荣幸]。

examples.english: He always tells the truth because he has a sense of [honor].
examples.chinese: 他总是说真话，因为他有[荣誉感]。

meanings.explanation: If you [honor] someone, you treat them with special respect or give them public praise for something they have done.

examples.english: The school will [honor] the teacher who has worked for 30 years.
examples.chinese: 学校将[表彰]这位工作了30年的老师。

examples.english: We gather here to [honor] our brave firefighters.
examples.chinese: 我们聚集在这里[致敬]我们勇敢的消防员。

examples.english: The city decided to [honor] the young hero with a special ceremony.
examples.chinese: 这座城市决定举行特别仪式来[表彰]这位小英雄。

meanings.explanation: If you [encourage] someone, you give them hope, confidence, or support, especially when they are feeling nervous, sad, or unsure about something.

examples.english: My teacher always [encourages] me when I feel nervous about speaking in class.
examples.chinese: 我上课发言紧张时，老师总是[鼓励]我。

examples.english: My parents [encouraged] me with warm words before the piano exam.
examples.chinese: 钢琴考试前，爸爸妈妈用温暖的话[鼓励]了我。

examples.english: A good friend will always [encourage] you when you feel down.
examples.chinese: 好朋友会在你心情低落时[鼓励]你。

meanings.explanation: If you [encourage] someone to do something, you try to persuade them to do it by telling them it is a good thing to do or that they have the ability to do it.

examples.english: My dad [encouraged] me to learn how to ride a bike.
examples.chinese: 爸爸[鼓励]我学骑自行车。

examples.english: The teacher [encouraged] us to read at least one book every week.
examples.chinese: 老师[鼓励]我们每周至少读一本书。

examples.english: She [encouraged] her little brother to try the vegetables.
examples.chinese: 她[鼓励]弟弟尝一尝蔬菜。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [illegal] is not allowed by law or is against the law.

examples.english: It is [illegal] to smoke in this building.
examples.chinese: 这栋楼里吸烟是[违法]的。

examples.english: The [illegal] parking was fined by the police.
examples.chinese: 那辆[非法]停放的汽车被警察罚款了。

examples.english: He was caught for [illegal] voting.
examples.chinese: 他因[非法]投票被抓了。

meanings.explanation: If people [go hungry], they do not have enough food to eat, or they do not eat when they want or need to.

examples.english: If you don't eat breakfast, you will [go hungry] before lunch.
examples.chinese: 如果你不吃早饭，到中午就会[饿肚子]。

examples.english: Many stray cats [go hungry] during the cold winter months.
examples.chinese: 很多流浪猫在寒冷的冬天都[吃不饱]。

examples.english: Mom packed lots of food so we wouldn't [go hungry] on our trip.
examples.chinese: 妈妈带了好多吃的，这样我们路上就不会[挨饿]了。

meanings.explanation: If you do something [instead] of something else, you do it in place of that other thing.

examples.english: I want to drink juice [instead] of water.
examples.chinese: 我想喝果汁，[而不是]水。

examples.english: She drew a cat [instead] of a dog.
examples.chinese: 她画了一只猫，[而不是]狗。

examples.english: Let's walk to school [instead] of taking the bus.
examples.chinese: 咱们走路去上学吧，[而不是]坐公交车。

meanings.explanation: You use [instead] to say that something is done when you might expect something different to happen.

examples.english: It rained, but we played inside [instead].
examples.chinese: 下雨了，不过我们[改在]室内玩了。

examples.english: He didn't cry. He smiled [instead].
examples.chinese: 他没有哭，[而是]笑了。

examples.english: I forgot my lunch, so I bought a sandwich [instead].
examples.chinese: 我忘带午饭了，所以[改]买了个三明治。

common_collocations: however much / however long / however hard

meanings.explanation: You use [however] to introduce a statement that contrasts with what was just said. It means 'but' or 'on the other hand.'

examples.english: The test was really hard. [However], I did my best.
examples.chinese: 考试真的好难。[不过]，我尽力了。

examples.english: It was raining outside. [However], we still went out to play.
examples.chinese: 外面下着雨。[不过]，我们还是出去玩儿了。

examples.english: I don't like carrots. [However], my mom says they are good for me.
examples.chinese: 我不喜欢吃胡萝卜。[但是]，妈妈说胡萝卜对身体好。

meanings.explanation: You use [however] before an adjective or adverb to mean 'no matter how.' It shows that something is true in every possible way.

examples.english: [However] tired you are, you should finish your homework first.
examples.chinese: [不管]你有多累，都应该先写完作业。

examples.english: [However] hard I try, I can't tie my shoes like my brother.
examples.chinese: [不管]我怎么努力，都没法像哥哥那样系鞋带。

examples.english: [However] late it gets, Dad always waits for me at the gate.
examples.chinese: [不管]天有多晚，爸爸总是在大门口等我。

meanings.explanation: [Independence] is the freedom that a country gains when it stops being ruled or controlled by another country.

examples.english: Many countries fought for their [independence] many years ago.
examples.chinese: 许多国家多年前为争取[独立]而战。

examples.english: The country celebrated its 50th year of [independence] last week.
examples.chinese: 这个国家上周庆祝了获得[独立]50周年。

examples.english: Our school teaches us about the history of our country's [independence].
examples.chinese: 我们学校给我们讲了我国[独立]的历史。

meanings.explanation: [Independence] is the freedom to make your own decisions and live your own life without being controlled by other people.

examples.english: Teenagers should learn to get more [independence] from their parents.
examples.chinese: 青少年应该学会从父母那里获得更多[独立]。

examples.english: She values her [independence] and likes doing things by herself.
examples.chinese: 她珍惜自己的[独立]，喜欢自己做事。

examples.english: Learning to cook helps you gain [independence] when you live alone.
examples.chinese: 学习做饭能帮你在独居时获得[独立]。

meanings.explanation: An [item] is a single thing or object, especially one that is part of a list, group, or set.

examples.english: Please put your [items] on the counter one by one.
examples.chinese: 请把你的[物品]一件一件放在柜台上。

examples.english: The first [item] on my shopping list is milk.
examples.chinese: 购物清单上的第一个[物品]是牛奶。

examples.english: Each [item] in this store costs less than ten dollars.
examples.chinese: 这家商店里的每一件[商品]都不到十美元。

meanings.explanation: A [news item] is a short piece of information in a newspaper, on television, or on the radio.

examples.english: Did you see the [item] about the school fair on TV?
examples.chinese: 你看到电视上关于学校集市的[新闻]了吗？

examples.english: There was an interesting [item] in today's newspaper about animals.
examples.chinese: 今天的报纸上有一则关于动物的有趣[报道]。

examples.english: The last [item] on the news was about a missing dog.
examples.chinese: 新闻的最后一则[消息]是关于一只走失的狗。

meanings.explanation: A [legend] is a very old story from ancient times that people tell about famous people or events, often involving magic or heroic deeds.

examples.english: I love reading the [legend] of King Arthur before bed.
examples.chinese: 睡前我喜欢读亚瑟王的[传说]。

examples.english: My grandma told me a [legend] about a dragon living in the river.
examples.chinese: 奶奶给我讲了一个关于河里住着龙的[传说]。

examples.english: The [legend] says there is a treasure hidden on this mountain.
examples.chinese: [传说]这座山上藏有宝藏。

meanings.explanation: If you describe someone as a [legend], you mean they are very famous and admired, often because they are extremely good at something.

examples.english: My grandfather is a [legend] in our family because he once climbed the highest mountain.
examples.chinese: 我爷爷是我们家的一位[传奇人物]，因为他曾经爬过最高的山。

examples.english: Many kids think Messi is a football [legend].
examples.chinese: 很多孩子都认为梅西是足球[传奇]。

examples.english: She is a [legend] at singing in our school.
examples.chinese: 她是我们学校唱歌的[传奇人物]。

meanings.explanation: If you [locate] something, you find out its exact position or where it is.

examples.english: Can you help me [locate] the library on this map?
examples.chinese: 你能帮我在地图上[找到]图书馆的位置吗？

examples.english: I use my phone to [locate] the nearest bus stop.
examples.chinese: 我用手机来[定位]最近的公交站。

examples.english: It took us an hour to [locate] the lost cat.
examples.chinese: 我们花了一个小时才[找到]那只走丢的猫。

meanings.explanation: If something is [located] in a particular place, it is situated or built there.

examples.english: Our new school is [located] near the park.
examples.chinese: 我们的新学校[位于]公园附近。

examples.english: The hospital is [located] at the end of this street.
examples.chinese: 医院就[坐落]在这条街的尽头。

examples.english: The restaurant is [located] on the second floor of the mall.
examples.chinese: 那家餐厅[位于]商场的二楼。

meanings.explanation: An [introduction] is the act of making someone known to another person, usually by telling each person's name when they meet for the first time.

examples.english: Our teacher made a friendly [introduction] between the two new students.
examples.chinese: 老师友好地把两个新同学互相[介绍]了一下。

examples.english: She was too nervous to make an [introduction] at the party.
examples.chinese: 她太紧张了，在派对上不敢做自我[介绍]。

examples.english: A warm [introduction] can help everyone feel comfortable.
examples.chinese: 热情的[介绍]能让大家都感到自在。

meanings.explanation: An [introduction] is the first part of something such as a book, speech, or course that gives basic information about what is to follow.

examples.english: I always read the [introduction] of a book before the first chapter.
examples.chinese: 我总会在读第一章之前先看书的[前言]。

examples.english: The teacher gave us a quick [introduction] to the new subject.
examples.chinese: 老师快速给我们[介绍]了一下这门新科目。

examples.english: He started his speech with a short [introduction] about himself.
examples.chinese: 他以一段简短的自我[介绍]开始了他的演讲。

meanings.explanation: A [liquid] is a substance that flows freely and takes the shape of its container, like water, milk, or juice.

examples.english: Water is a clear [liquid] that we drink every day.
examples.chinese: 水是我们每天喝的透明[液体]。

examples.english: Milk is a white [liquid] that comes from cows.
examples.chinese: 牛奶是来自奶牛的白色[液体]。

examples.english: Please pour the [liquid] into the cup carefully.
examples.chinese: 请小心地把[液体]倒进杯子里。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [liquid] is in a form that flows like water, not hard like a solid.

examples.english: Water is ice in its [liquid] form.
examples.chinese: 水是冰的[液态]形式。

examples.english: My mom buys [liquid] soap for our bathroom.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈给浴室买[液体]肥皂。

examples.english: The [liquid] medicine is easier for kids to swallow.
examples.chinese: [液体]药物更容易让孩子吞服。

meanings.explanation: A [honour] is a quality of good character that involves being honest, fair, and respected by other people, or a special privilege that makes you feel proud.

examples.english: The hero brought [honour] to his whole village.
examples.chinese: 这位英雄给他全村带来了[荣誉]。

examples.english: It is such a great [honour] to be invited to your birthday party.
examples.chinese: 能受邀参加你的生日派对，真是我的莫大[荣幸]。

examples.english: We held a special dinner in [honour] of our retiring headmaster.
examples.chinese: 我们办了一场特别的晚餐，向即将退休的校长表达[敬意]。

meanings.explanation: If you [honour] a promise, agreement, or person, you do what you promised to do, or you show great respect for them.

examples.english: You must [honour] your promise to take me to the zoo.
examples.chinese: 你必须[信守]带我去动物园的承诺。

examples.english: We [honour] our parents for their love and care.
examples.chinese: 我们[尊敬]父母给予我们的爱和照顾。

examples.english: The city held a parade to [honour] the winning sports team.
examples.chinese: 这座城市举办了游行，[表彰]获胜的运动队。

meanings.explanation: Your [imagination] is your ability to form new ideas, pictures, or stories in your mind.

examples.english: Reading books can help develop a child's [imagination].
examples.chinese: 读书能培养孩子的[想象力]。

examples.english: Close your eyes and use your [imagination] to draw a picture in your mind.
examples.chinese: 闭上眼睛，发挥[想象力]，在脑海里画一幅画。

examples.english: My little sister has a wonderful [imagination] — she can play make-believe for hours.
examples.chinese: 我妹妹的[想象力]特别棒——她能玩过家家玩好几个小时。

meanings.explanation: If something is just your [imagination], it is not real but only exists in your mind.

examples.english: Don't worry, the noise you heard was just your [imagination].
examples.chinese: 别担心，你听到的声音只是你的[想象]。

examples.english: The monster in the closet is only in his [imagination].
examples.chinese: 衣柜里的怪物只存在于他的[想象]中。

examples.english: Her [imagination] turned the garden into a magical castle.
examples.chinese: 她的[想象]把花园变成了一座神奇的城堡。

meanings.explanation: A [lifestyle] is the way in which a person lives, including where they live, what they eat, and the activities they enjoy.

examples.english: My grandmother lives a very simple [lifestyle].
examples.chinese: 我奶奶过着非常简单[的生活方式]。

examples.english: We moved to the city for a better [lifestyle].
examples.chinese: 为了更好的[生活方式]，我们搬到了城市。

examples.english: She has a very healthy [lifestyle] — she exercises every day.
examples.chinese: 她有非常健康的[生活方式]——她每天锻炼。

meanings.explanation: If someone [holds the record] in a sport or competition, they have achieved the best result ever, such as the fastest time or the highest score.

examples.english: She [holds the record] for the longest jump in our school.
examples.chinese: 她在我们学校[保持]着跳远[纪录]。

examples.english: The swimmer [holds the world record] for the 100-meter race.
examples.chinese: 这位游泳运动员在100米比赛中[保持世界纪录]。

examples.english: Our class read the most books this month and [held the record].
examples.chinese: 我们班这个月读书最多，[保持纪录]。

meanings.explanation: If someone [holds the record] for doing something unusual or extreme, they have done it for longer or more times than anyone else.

examples.english: He [holds the record] for staying awake the longest without sleep.
examples.chinese: 他在熬夜时长方面[保持纪录]。

examples.english: This old tree [holds the record] for being the tallest in the forest.
examples.chinese: 这棵老树在森林里[保持]着最高的[纪录]。

examples.english: My grandma [holds the record] for baking the biggest birthday cake!
examples.chinese: 我奶奶烤的生日蛋糕最大，[保持纪录]！

meanings.explanation: If something is [likely], it will probably happen or is probably true.

examples.english: It is [likely] that she will come to the party.
examples.chinese: 她[很可能]会来参加派对。

examples.english: She is the [likely] winner of the contest.
examples.chinese: 她是比赛最[有可能]的获胜者。

examples.english: A [likely] reason for his absence is that he is sick.
examples.chinese: 他缺席的一个[可能]原因是生病了。

meanings.explanation: You use [likely] to say that something will probably happen or is probably true.

examples.english: He will [likely] arrive late because of the traffic.
examples.chinese: 因为堵车，他[很可能]会晚到。

examples.english: She will [likely] choose the blue dress for the party.
examples.chinese: 她[很可能]会选那条蓝裙子去派对。

examples.english: They will [likely] finish their homework before dinner.
examples.chinese: 他们[很可能]会在晚饭前做完作业。

meanings.explanation: A [landmark] is an easily recognized building or place that is often historically important, used for navigation or visited by tourists.

examples.english: We visited the Great Wall, a famous Chinese [landmark].
examples.chinese: 我们参观了中国著名的[地标]长城。

examples.english: The big lighthouse is the most famous [landmark] on this part of the coast.
examples.chinese: 这座大灯塔是这片海岸最有名的[地标]。

examples.english: When I walk to school, I use the old oak tree as a [landmark] to know I'm going the right way.
examples.chinese: 我走路去学校时，会把这棵老橡树当作[地标]来确认方向没错。

meanings.explanation: A [landmark] is an important event, decision, or discovery that marks a significant stage in the development of something.

examples.english: The first trip to the moon was a great [landmark] in human exploration.
examples.chinese: 首次登月是人类探索史上的一个重要[里程碑]。

examples.english: This new law is a [landmark] in keeping kids safe online.
examples.chinese: 这项新法律是保障儿童上网安全的一个[里程碑]。

examples.english: Learning to ride a bike without help was a [landmark] in my little sister's life.
examples.chinese: 学会不借助帮助骑自行车是我妹妹人生中的一个[里程碑]。

meanings.explanation: Something that is [man-made] is made by people, not by nature; artificial or synthetic.

examples.english: There is a beautiful [man-made] lake in the park near my house.
examples.chinese: 我家附近的公园里有一个漂亮的[人工]湖。

examples.english: This dress is made of [man-made] fabric, so it is cheaper.
examples.chinese: 这件裙子是[人造]布料做的，所以比较便宜。

examples.english: The bridge was built over a [man-made] canal.
examples.chinese: 那座桥建在一条[人工]运河上。

meanings.explanation: A [master] is a person who is very skilled at doing something or who knows a lot about a particular subject.

examples.english: My uncle is a [master] of making wooden toys.
examples.chinese: 我叔叔是制作木制玩具的[能手]。

examples.english: This beautiful painting was made by a famous [master].
examples.chinese: 这幅漂亮的画出自一位著名[大师]之手。

examples.english: After ten years of practice, she became a [master] of piano.
examples.chinese: 经过十年练习，她成为了一名钢琴[大师]。

meanings.explanation: If you [master] a skill or subject, you gain complete knowledge or skill in it.

examples.english: It takes lots of practice to [master] a new language.
examples.chinese: [掌握]一门新语言需要大量练习。

examples.english: He swims every day to [master] the skill.
examples.chinese: 他每天游泳来[掌握]这项技能。

examples.english: You must [master] basic math first.
examples.chinese: 你必须先[掌握]基础数学。

meanings.explanation: If you [memorize] something, you learn it so that you can remember it exactly.

examples.english: I need to [memorize] ten new words every day.
examples.chinese: 我每天都要[背]十个新单词。

examples.english: She can [memorize] a whole song after listening to it twice.
examples.chinese: 她听两遍就能[记住]整首歌。

examples.english: Please [memorize] your home address and phone number.
examples.chinese: 请[背下]你家的地址和电话号码。

meanings.explanation: A [material] is a substance that things can be made from.

examples.english: This shirt is made of soft [material].
examples.chinese: 这件衬衫是用柔软的[布料]做的。

examples.english: Wood is a common [material] for building houses.
examples.chinese: 木头是建造房屋的常见[材料]。

examples.english: She bought some shiny [material] to make a dress.
examples.chinese: 她买了一些亮闪闪的[布料]来做裙子。

meanings.explanation: Information, ideas, or evidence that can be used for a particular purpose is [material].

examples.english: I need to collect [material] for my school project.
examples.chinese: 我需要为我的学校项目收集[资料]。

examples.english: This book has great [material] for my report.
examples.chinese: 这本书里有很好的[素材]可以用在我的报告里。

examples.english: The teacher gave us some reading [material] to study.
examples.chinese: 老师给了我们一些阅读[材料]来学习。

meanings.explanation: A [mukbang] is an online video or live show in which a host eats a large amount of food while talking to the audience. The word comes from Korean and has become popular around the world.

examples.english: I like watching [mukbang] videos before I go to sleep.
examples.chinese: 我喜欢睡觉前看[吃播]视频。

examples.english: My sister is a [mukbang] star on the internet.
examples.chinese: 我姐姐是网上的[吃播]明星。

examples.english: In a [mukbang] show, the person eats a lot of yummy food.
examples.chinese: 在[吃播]节目里，人会吃很多好吃的食物。

meanings.explanation: [Migration] is the movement of a large group of animals or people from one place to another, especially to find food, better weather, or a new home.

examples.english: Every autumn, we watch the [migration] of birds flying south to find warmth.
examples.chinese: 每年秋天，我们都会观看鸟儿飞往南方寻找温暖的[迁徙]。

examples.english: The [migration] of people from villages to big cities is happening everywhere.
examples.chinese: 人们从乡村向大城市的[迁移]到处都在发生。

examples.english: Scientists follow the [migration] of whales across the ocean.
examples.chinese: 科学家们追踪鲸鱼横跨海洋的[洄游]。

meanings.explanation: [Literature] refers to novels, poems, and other written works, especially those that are considered to have high artistic quality and lasting importance.

examples.english: We study Chinese [literature] in our language class.
examples.chinese: 我们在语文课上学习中国[文学]。

examples.english: My big sister loves reading classic [literature] on weekends.
examples.chinese: 我姐姐周末喜欢读经典[文学作品]。

examples.english: This city library has a big section for children's [literature].
examples.chinese: 这家城市图书馆有一大块区域是儿童[文学]。

meanings.explanation: [Literature] is all the written or printed information or materials about a particular subject.

examples.english: The vet read [literature] about cat health to help my sick kitten.
examples.chinese: 兽医阅读了关于猫咪健康的[文献]来帮助我生病的小猫。

examples.english: You can find lots of [literature] about growing flowers at the library.
examples.chinese: 你可以在图书馆找到很多关于种花的[资料]。

examples.english: This [literature] tells us how to play the new board game.
examples.chinese: 这份[资料]告诉我们怎么玩这个新桌游。

meanings.explanation: [Organic] food or crops are grown without the use of artificial chemicals such as fertilizers or pesticides.

examples.english: My mom always buys [organic] vegetables for our family.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈总是给我们家买[有机的]蔬菜。

examples.english: This store sells only [organic] fruit from local farms.
examples.chinese: 这家商店只出售当地农场的[有机]水果。

examples.english: Many people believe [organic] food is healthier.
examples.chinese: 许多人认为[有机]食品更健康。

meanings.explanation: [Organic] describes something that is produced by or from living things, relating to the natural processes of life.

examples.english: The soil is full of [organic] matter from decayed leaves.
examples.chinese: 土壤里满是腐烂树叶形成的[有机]物。

examples.english: Farmers use [organic] waste to make compost for plants.
examples.chinese: 农民用[有机]废料制作植物的堆肥。

examples.english: Worms help break down [organic] material in the garden.
examples.chinese: 蚯蚓帮助分解花园里的[有机]物质。

meanings.explanation: Your [memory] is your ability to store and recall past experiences and information.

examples.english: I have a good [memory] for names.
examples.chinese: 我[记]名字特别厉害。

examples.english: She lost her [memory] after the accident.
examples.chinese: 那次事故后，她失去了[记忆]。

examples.english: Old people sometimes have a weak [memory].
examples.chinese: 老年人有时候[记]性不好。

meanings.explanation: [Memories] are past experiences or events that you remember and think about.

examples.english: This photo brings back nice [memories].
examples.chinese: 这张照片让我想起了美好的[回忆]。

examples.english: We keep [memories] of our pet in this album.
examples.chinese: 我们在这本相册里保存着宠物的[纪念照]。

examples.english: The park has special [memories] for our family.
examples.chinese: 这个公园承载着我们全家的美好[回忆]。

meanings.explanation: The [outer] parts of something are the parts which contain or enclose the other parts, or which are furthest from the centre.

examples.english: The [outer] layer of the onion is a bit dry.
examples.chinese: 洋葱的[外层]有点干了。

examples.english: Please wipe the [outer] surface of the window.
examples.chinese: 请把窗户的[外层]表面擦一下。

examples.english: There is a small hole in the [outer] wall of the house.
examples.chinese: 房子的[外墙]上有一个小洞。

meanings.explanation: An [outer] area or place is one that is on the edge of a larger area, far from the centre.

examples.english: They live in the [outer] part of the city.
examples.chinese: 他们住在城市的[外围]。

examples.english: The [outer] suburbs have larger houses and more trees.
examples.chinese: [外围]郊区的房子更大，树也更多。

examples.english: We walked to the [outer] edge of the park and sat down.
examples.chinese: 我们走到公园的[外沿]，坐了下来。

meanings.explanation: If you describe someone as [mature], you mean they behave in a sensible, responsible way that is typical of an adult.

examples.english: My big brother is very [mature] for his age.
examples.chinese: 我哥哥在他这个年纪非常[成熟]。

examples.english: A [mature] person doesn't throw tantrums when things go wrong.
examples.chinese: [成熟]的人不会遇到不顺就乱发脾气。

examples.english: When I become more [mature], I want to help take care of my little sister.
examples.chinese: 等我变得更[成熟]，我想帮忙照顾我的小妹妹。

meanings.explanation: [Mature] plants, fruit, and trees are fully grown and fully developed.

examples.english: These [mature] apples are sweet and ready to pick.
examples.chinese: 这些[成熟]的苹果很甜，可以采摘了。

examples.english: The [mature] oak tree in our yard gives us cool shade in summer.
examples.chinese: 我们院子里这棵[成熟]的橡树夏天给我们带来凉爽的树荫。

examples.english: Green bananas are not tasty—you need to wait until they are [mature].
examples.chinese: 青香蕉不好吃，你得等它们[成熟]了再吃。

meanings.explanation: A [misunderstanding] is a disagreement or problem caused when people do not understand each other correctly.

examples.english: We had a small [misunderstanding] about where to meet.
examples.chinese: 我们在见面地点上有个小小的[误会]。

examples.english: She called me to clear up the [misunderstanding].
examples.chinese: 她打电话给我澄清了这场[误会]。

examples.english: A small [misunderstanding] made them stop talking to each other.
examples.chinese: 一场小小的[误会]让他们不再和对方说话了。

meanings.explanation: A [misunderstanding] is a failure to understand something correctly.

examples.english: His [misunderstanding] of the question led to a wrong answer.
examples.chinese: 他对问题的[误解]导致了错误答案。

examples.english: This [misunderstanding] came from reading the text too fast.
examples.chinese: 这个[误解]是因为读文章太快造成的。

examples.english: You can ask your teacher to correct any [misunderstanding].
examples.chinese: 你可以请老师纠正任何[误解]。

meanings.explanation: A [palace] is a very large and impressive house where a king, queen, or other important person lives.

examples.english: The king and queen live in a beautiful [palace].
examples.chinese: 国王和王后住在一座美丽的[宫殿]里。

examples.english: We visited an old [palace] during our summer holiday.
examples.chinese: 暑假期间我们参观了一座古老的[宫殿]。

examples.english: The princess lives in a golden [palace] on the hill.
examples.chinese: 公主住在山上的一座金色[宫殿]里。

meanings.explanation: If you [mention] something or someone, you say something about them, usually in a short or casual way.

examples.english: Did your mom [mention] the party tonight?
examples.chinese: 你妈妈[提到]今晚的派對了嗎？

examples.english: Please don't [mention] this to anyone else.
examples.chinese: 請別跟別人[提起]這件事。

examples.english: He [mentioned] that he was tired after the long walk.
examples.chinese: 他[提到]走了很長的路之後他累了。

meanings.explanation: A [mention] is a short comment about someone or something, or the act of referring to them briefly.

examples.english: There was a [mention] of our school in the newspaper.
examples.chinese: 報紙上對我們學校有[提及]。

examples.english: She gave a special [mention] to her teacher in her speech.
examples.chinese: 她在演講中對老師做了特別[提及]。

examples.english: The movie got a [mention] on a popular website.
examples.chinese: 這部電影在一個熱門網站上得到了[提及]。

meanings.explanation: The [origin] of something is the point, place, or situation where it begins or is created from.

examples.english: The [origin] of this small river is high in the mountains.
examples.chinese: 这条小河的[源头]在高山上。

examples.english: We learned about the [origin] of chocolate in school today.
examples.chinese: 我们今天在学校学习了巧克力的[起源]。

examples.english: Do you know the [origin] of your favorite story?
examples.chinese: 你知道你最喜欢的故事的[起源]吗？

meanings.explanation: A person's or family's [origin] is the place or country that their ancestors originally came from.

examples.english: My best friend is of Japanese [origin] but grew up in Canada.
examples.chinese: 我最好的朋友是日本[血统]，但在加拿大长大。

examples.english: My grandfather's place of [origin] is a tiny village in Spain.
examples.chinese: 我祖父的[原籍]是西班牙的一个小村庄。

examples.english: Grandma never talks about her family [origin].
examples.chinese: 奶奶从来不谈论她的家族[出身]。

meanings.explanation: A [president] is the leader of a country, an organization, or a group, who has been elected or chosen to represent and manage it.

examples.english: The [president] of our country gave a speech on TV today.
examples.chinese: 我们国家的[总统]今天在电视上发表了演讲。

examples.english: She wants to be the [president] of the student council.
examples.chinese: 她想当学生会[主席]。

examples.english: Our school [president] is a very kind and funny man.
examples.chinese: 我们学校的[校长]是一个很和蔼又风趣的人。

meanings.explanation: If you [overcome] a problem, difficulty, or fear, you successfully deal with it or defeat it.

examples.english: She worked hard to [overcome] her fear of water.
examples.chinese: 她努力[克服]了对水的恐惧。

examples.english: We can [overcome] any difficulty if we work together.
examples.chinese: 只要我们齐心协力，就能[战胜]任何困难。

examples.english: He [overcame] many difficulties to achieve his dream.
examples.chinese: 他[克服]了许多困难才实现了梦想。

meanings.explanation: If you are [overcome] by a feeling or an event, it affects you so strongly that you cannot think or act normally.

examples.english: She was [overcome] with joy when she saw the surprise.
examples.chinese: 看到惊喜时，她[激动]得说不出话来。

examples.english: The firefighters were [overcome] by smoke.
examples.chinese: 消防员被浓烟[熏倒]了。

examples.english: He was [overcome] with sadness at the news.
examples.chinese: 听到这个消息，他[悲痛]不已。

meanings.explanation: If you [pass] a person, place, or object, you go past them while moving from one place to another.

examples.english: We [pass] a park on our way to school.
examples.chinese: 我们上学路上会[经过]一个公园。

examples.english: The blue bike [passed] our house ten minutes ago.
examples.chinese: 那辆蓝色自行车十分钟前[经过]了我们家。

examples.english: Could you let me [pass]—I need to get off the bus.
examples.chinese: 你能让我[过去]吗——我要下公交车了。

meanings.explanation: If you [pass] something to another person, you give it to them using your hand.

examples.english: Can you [pass] me the bottle of water?
examples.chinese: 你能把这瓶水[递]给我吗？

examples.english: My mom [passed] me a slice of cake at dinner.
examples.chinese: 晚饭时妈妈[递]给我一块蛋糕。

examples.english: Please [pass] the note to your deskmate.
examples.chinese: 请把这张纸条[递]给你的同桌。

meanings.explanation: An [online] activity or service is one that you do or use on the internet.

examples.english: My sister takes an [online] art class every Saturday.
examples.chinese: 我姐姐每星期六上[线上]美术课。

examples.english: We bought these books from an [online] store.
examples.chinese: 这些书是我们从一家[网上]书店买的。

examples.english: Many kids play [online] games after finishing their homework.
examples.chinese: 很多孩子做完作业后玩[网络]游戏。

meanings.explanation: If you do something [online], you do it using the internet.

examples.english: I like to chat [online] with my friends after school.
examples.chinese: 放学后我喜欢[在网上]和朋友聊天。

examples.english: You can pay your bills [online] now.
examples.chinese: 你现在可以[在网上]付账单了。

examples.english: We often look up new words [online].
examples.chinese: 我们经常[在网上]查生词。

meanings.explanation: Someone who is [patient] is able to wait calmly without getting annoyed or upset, or remains calm when dealing with difficult situations.

examples.english: Please be [patient] and wait for your turn.
examples.chinese: 请[耐心]等待，轮到你再说。

examples.english: She is very [patient] with her little brother.
examples.chinese: 她对弟弟非常[有耐心]。

examples.english: The teacher was [patient] when explaining the lesson.
examples.chinese: 老师讲解课时非常[耐心]。

meanings.explanation: A [patient] is a person who is receiving medical treatment from a doctor or is visiting a hospital, clinic, or doctor's office.

examples.english: The [patient] is recovering well after the surgery.
examples.chinese: 这位[病人]手术后恢复得很好。

examples.english: There are many [patients] waiting in the hospital lobby.
examples.chinese: 医院大厅里有很多[病人在]等待。

examples.english: My mother is a [patient] of Dr. Smith.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈是史密斯医生的[病人]。

meanings.explanation: [Past] means happening or existing before the present time.

examples.english: I learned a lot from [past] mistakes.
examples.chinese: 我从[过去的]错误中吸取了很多教训。

examples.english: We should not forget [past] heroes.
examples.chinese: 我们不该忘记[过去的]英雄。

examples.english: She has been my friend for the [past] three years.
examples.chinese: 在[过去的]三年里，她一直是我的好朋友。

meanings.explanation: The [past] is the time before the present moment, or the events that happened before now.

examples.english: Don't worry about the [past].
examples.chinese: 别为[过去]的事烦心了。

examples.english: We can learn a lot from the [past].
examples.chinese: 我们可以从[过去]学到很多东西。

examples.english: In the [past], people didn't have phones.
examples.chinese: 在[过去]，人们没有手机。

meanings.explanation: [Research] is careful study of a subject, especially to discover new facts or information about it.

examples.english: My sister did a lot of [research] about animals for her school project.
examples.chinese: 我姐姐为学校的课题做了大量关于动物的[研究]。

examples.english: The library is a great place to find books for your [research].
examples.chinese: 图书馆是寻找[研究]资料的好地方。

examples.english: After months of [research], they found a new way to save water.
examples.chinese: 经过数月的[研究]，他们发现了一种节水的新方法。

meanings.explanation: If you [research] something, you study it carefully to find out new facts or information.

examples.english: I need to [research] different types of birds for my homework.
examples.chinese: 我需要为家庭作业[研究]不同种类的鸟。

examples.english: She spent the weekend [researching] healthy food recipes.
examples.chinese: 她整个周末都在[研究]健康食谱。

examples.english: Scientists [research] how plants grow in space.
examples.chinese: 科学家们[研究]植物如何在太空中生长。

meanings.explanation: A [product] is something that is made or grown to be sold, usually in a store or market.

examples.english: My mom bought a new cleaning [product] from the store.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈从商店买了一种新的清洁[产品]。

examples.english: This company makes dairy [products] like milk and cheese.
examples.chinese: 这家公司生产牛奶和奶酪等乳制[品]。

examples.english: The [product] we sell the most is chocolate.
examples.chinese: 我们卖得最多的[产品]是巧克力。

meanings.explanation: A [product] is something that happens as a result of a particular process, action, or situation.

examples.english: A good grade is the [product] of studying hard.
examples.chinese: 好成绩是努力学习的[成果]。

examples.english: This drawing is the [product] of her imagination.
examples.chinese: 这幅画是她想象力的[产物]。

examples.english: Teamwork is the [product] of everyone helping each other.
examples.chinese: 团队合作是大家互相帮助的[结果]。

meanings.explanation: A [presentation] is a talk or display given to a group of people to share information, ideas, or a project.

examples.english: I will give a [presentation] about my favorite pet at school tomorrow.
examples.chinese: 明天我要在学校做一个关于我最爱的宠物的[展示]。

examples.english: Lily made colorful paper cards for her [presentation] on trees.
examples.chinese: 莉莉为她关于树木的[展示]做了五颜六色的卡片。

examples.english: My dad practiced his [presentation] for work all last night.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸昨晚一整晚都在练习他工作要用的[汇报]。

meanings.explanation: The [presentation] of something is the way it is arranged, shown, or offered to other people.

examples.english: The pretty [presentation] of the fruit salad made everyone want to eat it.
examples.chinese: 水果沙拉漂亮的[摆盘]让每个人都想吃它。

examples.english: The shopkeeper improved the [presentation] of all the toys in the window.
examples.chinese: 店主改进了橱窗里所有玩具的[陈列方式]。

examples.english: Grandma cares a lot about the [presentation] of food when she has guests.
examples.chinese: 奶奶请客的时候非常注重食物的[呈现方式]。

meanings.explanation: A [schedule] is a plan that lists all the things you need to do and the times when you will do them.

examples.english: The class [schedule] is on the wall near the door.
examples.chinese: 课程[表]贴在门口旁边的墙上。

examples.english: I made a [schedule] for my homework today.
examples.chinese: 我给今天的作业做了个[安排表]。

examples.english: The bus [schedule] says the next bus comes at three.
examples.chinese: 公交[时刻表]上写着下一班车三点到。

meanings.explanation: If you [schedule] something, you decide when it will happen and put it into your plan.

examples.english: We [scheduled] a picnic for this Saturday.
examples.chinese: 我们[安排]这周六去野餐。

examples.english: The doctor [scheduled] my appointment at ten o'clock.
examples.chinese: 医生把我的预约[安排]在十点钟。

examples.english: They [scheduled] a meeting to talk about the school trip.
examples.chinese: 他们[安排]了一次会议来讨论学校郊游的事。

meanings.explanation: [Peace] is a situation in which there is no war or fighting between countries or groups of people.

examples.english: We all want [peace] in the world.
examples.chinese: 我们都想要世界[和平]。

examples.english: After the long war, [peace] finally returned.
examples.chinese: 漫长战争之后，[和平]终于回归了。

examples.english: The two countries now live in [peace].
examples.chinese: 这两个国家现在生活在[和平]之中。

meanings.explanation: [Peace] is a calm and quiet feeling inside your mind, without any worries or stress.

examples.english: I like to sit by the lake and enjoy the [peace].
examples.chinese: 我喜欢坐在湖边享受[宁静]。

examples.english: Reading books brings me [peace] of mind.
examples.chinese: 读书给我带来内心的[平静]。

examples.english: She felt a sense of [peace] after the long walk.
examples.chinese: 走了很长的路之后，她感到一阵[安宁]。

meanings.explanation: A [shelter] is a small building or covered place that protects people from bad weather or danger.

examples.english: We waited for the bus in a small [shelter].
examples.chinese: 我们在一个小小的[候车亭]里等公交车。

examples.english: The animals found a [shelter] under the big tree.
examples.chinese: 动物们在大树下找到了一个[栖身之处]。

examples.english: This [shelter] keeps us dry when it rains.
examples.chinese: 这个[遮蔽处]让我们在下雨时不会淋湿。

meanings.explanation: To [shelter] means to protect someone or something from bad weather or danger by giving them a safe place.

examples.english: The big umbrella [sheltered] us from the rain.
examples.chinese: 那把大伞为我们[遮挡]了雨水。

examples.english: The cave [sheltered] the hikers during the storm.
examples.chinese: 山洞在暴风雨中为徒步者们[提供庇护]。

examples.english: She [sheltered] the little bird in a warm box.
examples.chinese: 她把小鸟[安置]在一个温暖的盒子里。

meanings.explanation: A [social] person enjoys being with other people and making friends easily.

examples.english: My brother is very [social] and loves going to parties.
examples.chinese: 我弟弟很[爱交际]，喜欢参加派对。

examples.english: She is a [social] butterfly who knows everyone in our school.
examples.chinese: 她是个[社交]达人，认识学校里所有的人。

examples.english: Dogs are [social] animals that need friends to play with.
examples.chinese: 狗是[群体性]动物，需要朋友一起玩耍。

meanings.explanation: [Social] activities or events involve spending time with other people for enjoyment.

examples.english: We have a [social] gathering at my house every weekend.
examples.chinese: 我们每周末都在我家举行[社交]聚会。

examples.english: The club organizes many [social] events for its members.
examples.chinese: 这个俱乐部为成员组织很多[社交]活动。

examples.english: Friday night is our [social] time to hang out with friends.
examples.chinese: 周五晚上是我们和朋友一起[社交]玩乐的时间。

meanings.explanation: [Security] refers to the state of being safe and protected from danger, threats, or harm.

examples.english: Our school has [security] guards at the gate.
examples.chinese: 我们学校门口有[保安]。

examples.english: I feel [security] when I'm with my family.
examples.chinese: 和家人在一起时我感到[安全]。

examples.english: The password helps keep our account [security].
examples.chinese: 密码有助于保护我们的账户[安全]。

meanings.explanation: [Security] can also refer to measures taken to protect a place or person against threats or crimes.

examples.english: The [security] camera caught the thief.
examples.chinese: [监控]摄像机拍到了那个小偷。

examples.english: We need better [security] at the airport.
examples.chinese: 我们的机场需要更好的[安保]。

examples.english: The bank has high [security] to protect money.
examples.chinese: 这家银行有高级别[安保]来保护资金。

meanings.explanation: [Reality] is the world and all the things that actually exist, rather than things that only exist in stories, dreams, or people's imaginations.

examples.english: Many kids think fairy tales are real, but they are not [reality].
examples.chinese: 很多孩子以为童话是真的，但它们并不是[现实]。

examples.english: Sometimes movies are more fun than [reality].
examples.chinese: 有时候电影比[现实]更有趣。

examples.english: My little sister still can't tell the difference between dream and [reality].
examples.chinese: 我小妹妹还分不清梦境和[现实]的区别。

meanings.explanation: The [reality] of a situation is the true facts about it, rather than what people believe or pretend it to be.

examples.english: Everyone thought the test would be easy, but the [reality] was that it was very hard.
examples.chinese: 所有人都以为考试会很简单，但[现实]是考试非常难。

examples.english: You have to accept the [reality] that we can't go to the park today.
examples.chinese: 你必须接受今天我们不能去公园这个[现实]。

examples.english: She pretended to be happy, but the [reality] was she felt sad.
examples.chinese: 她假装开心，但[现实]是她感到很难过。

meanings.explanation: A [spacecraft] is a vehicle or machine designed to travel in outer space, typically to carry astronauts, satellites, or other cargo beyond Earth's atmosphere.

examples.english: The [spacecraft] landed safely on the Moon.
examples.chinese: 这艘[宇宙飞船]安全降落在月球上。

examples.english: China sent a [spacecraft] to explore Mars last year.
examples.chinese: 中国去年发射了一艘[宇宙飞船]去探测火星。

examples.english: Astronauts live and work inside the [spacecraft] for many days.
examples.chinese: 宇航员在[宇宙飞船]里生活和工作很多天。

meanings.explanation: A [skill] is the ability to do something well, especially because you have learned and practiced it.

examples.english: She has a special [skill] for drawing animals.
examples.chinese: 她有画动物的[特长]。

examples.english: Good math [skill] helps you in everyday life.
examples.chinese: 好的数学[能力]在日常生活中很有用。

examples.english: Learning computer [skill] is important today.
examples.chinese: 学习电脑[技能]在当今很重要。

meanings.explanation: If you [respond] to a question or something someone has said, you say something back as a reply.

examples.english: I asked her name, but she didn't [respond].
examples.chinese: 我问了她的名字，但她没有[回答]。

examples.english: My mom always [responds] to my messages right away.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈总是马上[回复]我的消息。

examples.english: When I called the dog's name, he [responded] quickly.
examples.chinese: 当我叫这只狗的名字时，它很快就[回应]了我。

meanings.explanation: If you [respond] to a situation, problem, or need, you take action or react to it in a particular way.

examples.english: The doctors [responded] quickly to the emergency.
examples.chinese: 医生们对紧急情况迅速做出了[反应]。

examples.english: My plants [respond] well to lots of sunlight.
examples.chinese: 我的植物对充足的阳光[反应]良好。

examples.english: The fire truck [responded] to the call in ten minutes.
examples.chinese: 消防车十分钟内就[响应]了呼叫。

meanings.explanation: A [smartphone] is a mobile phone that can connect to the internet and be used like a small computer.

examples.english: My mom uses her [smartphone] to call Grandma every day.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈每天都用她的[智能手机]给奶奶打电话。

examples.english: I like to play educational games on my dad's [smartphone].
examples.chinese: 我喜欢在我爸爸的[智能手机]上玩益智游戏。

examples.english: A [smartphone] can take photos and send messages.
examples.chinese: [智能手机]可以拍照和发信息。

meanings.explanation: A [stem] is the main long thin part of a plant, above the ground, from which leaves or flowers grow.

examples.english: She put a flower with a long [stem] in the vase.
examples.chinese: 她把一朵[茎]很长的花插进了花瓶里。

examples.english: The [stem] of the tomato plant is green and strong.
examples.chinese: 番茄植株的[茎]又绿又壮。

examples.english: Some roses have thorns on their [stems].
examples.chinese: 有些玫瑰的[茎]上长着刺。

meanings.explanation: If a problem or situation [stems] from something, it is caused by it or develops as a result of it.

examples.english: His headache [stems] from not getting enough sleep.
examples.chinese: 他的头痛是睡眠不足[引起的]。

examples.english: Many arguments [stem] from small misunderstandings.
examples.chinese: 很多争吵都[源于]小小的误会。

examples.english: Her love for reading [stems] from her mother's influence.
examples.chinese: 她对阅读的热爱[源于]母亲的影响。

meanings.explanation: A [report] is a spoken or written account of something that you have seen, heard, done, or studied.

examples.english: I wrote a [report] about my summer vacation.
examples.chinese: 我写了一篇暑假[报告]。

examples.english: The weather [report] says it will be sunny today.
examples.chinese: 天气[预报]说今天会是晴天。

examples.english: We gave our book [report] in front of the class.
examples.chinese: 我们在全班面前做了读书[报告]。

meanings.explanation: If you [report] something that has happened, you tell people about it, especially in an official way or in the news.

examples.english: Please [report] any problems to your teacher.
examples.chinese: 有问题请向老师[报告]。

examples.english: The newspaper [reported] the good news yesterday.
examples.chinese: 报纸昨天[报道]了这个好消息。

examples.english: He [reported] his good grades to his parents.
examples.chinese: 他向父母[报告]了他的好成绩。

derived_forms: spun (v., past tense and past participle)

meanings.explanation: When something [spins], it turns around and around quickly.

examples.english: The top can [spin] very fast.
examples.chinese: 这个陀螺能[转]得很快。

examples.english: The dog likes to [spin] in circles when it is happy.
examples.chinese: 这只狗开心的时候喜欢[转]圈圈。

examples.english: My head began to [spin] after riding the merry-go-round.
examples.chinese: 坐完旋转木马后，我的头开始[发晕]。

meanings.explanation: A [spin] is a quick turning movement.

examples.english: Give the wheel a [spin] to win a prize.
examples.chinese: [转]一下轮盘来赢取奖品。

examples.english: The ice skater did a perfect [spin] on the ice.
examples.chinese: 那位滑冰运动员在冰面上做了一个完美的[旋转]。

examples.english: I took the new car for a [spin] around the block.
examples.chinese: 我开着新车绕着街区[兜了一圈]。

meanings.explanation: A [shift] is a fixed period of work time when one group of people works in a business that operates all day and night, before another group takes over.

examples.english: My mom works the night [shift] at the nearby hospital.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈在附近医院上[夜班]。
